17:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: Thanksgiving in America
Join CNN for the ultimate Thanksgiving morning watch party featuring a live view of parades across the country and special performances. Erica Hill, John Berman and Kasie Hunt anchor.

21:00 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: Vegas: The Story of Sin City
As Vegas grows into an entertainment and gambling mecca for tourists, mob syndicates, and performers, the city reflects the social ideals of the era.
